trigger: First locked-89 k-chain (k1 ~40% in) was aborted to apply determinism controls and restart all three replicates on identical code.

findings.temperature: 0.0 hard-coded for every repair and extraction request (deepseek_agent.py) - both arms, all runs

seed_parameter.test: two identical requests, temperature 0, seed 42, max_tokens 300
seed_parameter.result: HTTP 200 (accepted) but seed never echoed and outputs differed ('11,13,17' vs '11, 13, 17')
seed_parameter.conclusion: provider ignores seed; not a usable control

findings.residual_variance: provider-side sampling/routing cannot be pinned client-side; the measured single-run noise floor (~±3/30 on dev) includes it

controls_added.PYTHONHASHSEED: 0 for host trial subprocesses (cli.py env), the in-container science helper (HELPER), and the science command path - set iteration order is now stable across runs; trace_runtime already records the value in receipts
controls_added.time_allowance_text: rounded to whole minutes in both prompt builders (deepseek_agent, pier_agent) - removes per-attempt seconds drift ('1799' vs '1792')

implications: all three k replicates of the restarted locked-89 chain share byte-identical frozen source and these controls; the aborted k1 partial (64/178 receipts) is preserved under runs/deepseek-locked89-k1-v1 but is NOT part of the evaluation
